summary: PulseGuard v0.6.33 is a correctness and customer-experience release that fixes VSS false positives, Windows Update result serialization, post-servicing integrity verification/repair, component-store maintenance truth and cooldown behavior, per-application WinGet verification, ASUS OEM driver routing, application executable discovery, and Optimize-page resizing/scan-cancel behavior.

sections.heading: VSS writer truth is fixed
sections.detail: PulseGuard now parses each VSS writer by name, state and Last error. Stable + No error is healthy. Waiting for completion + No error is treated as transient and briefly rechecked instead of being counted as a failed writer. Only genuine problem states/errors create a VSS warning; no shadow copies are deleted.

sections.heading: Windows Update result handling is serialization-safe
sections.detail: The elevated Microsoft Update payload no longer collides with PowerShell's automatic $Error variable. Result rows are converted to plain serialization-safe values, JSON write failures fail closed, UNKNOWN/REVIEW states are warnings rather than OK, and per-update ResultCode/HRESULT evidence remains available for verification.

sections.heading: Late Windows integrity gate after servicing
sections.detail: After component-store, Windows Update and driver servicing changes, PulseGuard performs a deep DISM/SFC integrity recheck before final verification. Newly exposed repairable corruption routes through visible DISM /RestoreHealth and SFC /scannow, then independent CheckHealth/ScanHealth/verifyonly verification before VERIFIED_FIXED can be claimed.

sections.heading: CBS evidence no longer looks like a corruption count
sections.detail: Current-session CBS [SR] rows are separated into total session records and explicit fault/repair records. Routine Verify/transaction entries remain supporting evidence and are not presented as hundreds of corrupt files.

sections.heading: Component-store cleanup reports measured improvement and avoids immediate repeats
sections.detail: AnalyzeComponentStore now captures actual size, cache/temp size, reclaimable package count and last-cleanup time. A successful cleanup can report IMPROVED when packages/bytes were measurably reclaimed even if Windows still recommends more. A recent successful cleanup with no growth is deferred for seven days so customers are not immediately forced through another potentially very long servicing pass. /ResetBase remains prohibited.

sections.heading: WinGet updates are isolated and verified per application
sections.detail: PulseGuard inventories known-version upgrades, processes each exact package independently so one third-party installer cannot block the rest, then performs a fresh upgrade inventory plus an exact installed-version check before counting an application as updated. Failed/still-offered and unverified outcomes remain REVIEW/WARNING; packages with unknown installed versions are never blindly included.

sections.heading: ASUS OEM driver discovery uses exact board rules first
sections.detail: The Driver Engine now consumes the trusted exact motherboard support URL from PulseGuard vendor rules before fallback discovery, rejects ASUS redirects containing undefined route segments, and keeps automatic installs limited to hardware-ID matched, signed, non-downgrade packages. The Driver Engine is v0.2.4.

sections.heading: Application integrity resolves more real executables
sections.detail: Installed-application executable discovery now adds App Paths and strongly matched Start Menu shortcut targets to DisplayIcon/InstallLocation evidence. Apps that still cannot be proven remain UNVERIFIABLE rather than being falsely called healthy or corrupted.

sections.heading: Optimize screen resizing and close behavior improved
sections.detail: The Optimize workspace now fills the available page, recalculates the Changes Recorded and live-detail panel bounds on resize/maximize, keeps text/status controls inside their cards and lets the live details box use the remaining vertical space. A diagnostic-only Full Health worker can also be cancelled when the user closes PulseGuard; an active FIX + OPTIMIZE repair workflow still blocks unsafe closure.

sections.heading: Existing evidence-gated maintenance remains intact
sections.detail: Visible elevated repair/update commands still run one at a time and remain visible for five seconds after completion. CHKDSK /f, DNS repair, component maintenance, update recovery, storage optimization and other mutation paths remain evidence-gated and independently verified; destructive DiskPart cleanup, shadow-copy deletion, /ResetBase, blind boot rewrites and broad ACL resets remain outside automatic maintenance.
